finding.location: packages/migrations/retained-release-preflight.mjs: SELECT validation_status and subsequent row.validation_status_bytes check
finding.summary: The helper returns raw validation_status to Node and only afterward checks its byte length against 20. If direct database corruption replaces this text field with a very large value, PostgreSQL client materializes/transfers the string before complete scalar metadata preflight rejects it. This leaves a narrow oversized scalar allocation before rejection despite retained `files` staying unselected.
finding.suggested_resolution: Return a bounded equality fact such as validation_status='VALID' along with octet_length(validation_status), and validate only those scalar results in Node.
finding.limitations: Static preliminary source review only. No tests/builds/scans/lifecycle run. Does not assess final head, and does not claim exact-head security approval.
